title: oldenlandia leptocaulis
intro: Oldenlandia leptocaulis, commonly known as "five-angled oldenlandia" or "five-angled licorice root", is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a climbing or twining herb, native to Southeast Asia, used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia leptocaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
